name: First Born The
overview: The topic of the firstborn is deeply rooted in God's covenantal promises, as seen in His specific establishment of the covenant with Isaac, the chosen son of promise, rather than Ishmael (Genesis 17:19-21). The blessing and recognition of the firstborn's role is further illustrated in the patriarchal blessings upon Joseph's sons, Ephraim and Manasseh, where the right hand was intentionally placed to signify God's sovereign choice and blessing (Genesis 48:15-17). These passages emphasize the divine purpose and authority associated with the firstborn, reflecting God's sovereign will in the line of inheritance and blessing.
